text: The new office in Otterbach is on a large street just outside the old town.
reference: Das neue Büro in Otterbach liegt an einer grossen Strasse gleich ausserhalb der Altstadt.

text: Please do not leave your bike outside the main entrance. There is a large bike stand behind the gym.
reference: Bitte stellen Sie Ihr Velo nicht vor dem Haupteingang ab. Hinter der Turnhalle steht ein grosser Veloständer.

text:
Dear Mr Beispiel

Thank you for your registration. We will send you the course documents by the end of next week.

Kind regards
Nina Muster
reference:
Sehr geehrter Herr Beispiel

Vielen Dank für Ihre Anmeldung. Wir senden Ihnen die Kursunterlagen bis Ende nächster Woche.

Freundliche Grüsse
Nina Muster

text:
For the excursion on Friday, please bring:
- a packed lunch
- sturdy shoes
- a rain jacket
- your student ID
reference:
Bitte nehmen Sie für die Exkursion am Freitag Folgendes mit:
- ein Picknick
- feste Schuhe
- eine Regenjacke
- Ihren Studierendenausweis

text: Could you send me the slides from yesterday's meeting? I'd like to look at them again before the workshop.
reference: Kannst du mir die Folien von der gestrigen Sitzung schicken? Ich möchte sie mir vor dem Workshop noch einmal anschauen.

text: If it stays dry, we'll eat outside on the big terrace on Saturday.
reference: Wenn es trocken bleibt, essen wir am Samstag draussen auf der grossen Terrasse.

text: The Weidenhof school is closed on Monday because of a staff training day.
reference: Die Schule Weidenhof bleibt am Montag wegen eines Weiterbildungstags für das Personal geschlossen.

text: Sorry for the late reply. I was away for a few days and only saw your message today.
reference: Entschuldige die späte Antwort. Ich war ein paar Tage weg und habe deine Nachricht erst heute gesehen.

text: Please submit the completed form by 15 March at the latest. Late submissions cannot be considered.
reference: Bitte reichen Sie das ausgefüllte Formular bis spätestens 15. März ein. Verspätete Eingaben können nicht berücksichtigt werden.

text:
Before you leave the office:
- switch off the lights
- close the windows
- lock the door
reference:
Bevor du das Büro verlässt:
- das Licht ausschalten
- die Fenster schliessen
- die Tür abschliessen

text: Die Sitzung von morgen wird auf Donnerstag verschoben, weil Frau Muster krank ist.
reference: Tomorrow's meeting has been moved to Thursday because Ms Muster is ill.

text: Wer mit dem Velo nach Otterbach fährt, kann es beim Bahnhof gratis abstellen.
reference: Anyone cycling to Otterbach can park their bike at the station for free.

text:
Für die Anmeldung brauchen wir folgende Unterlagen:
- eine Kopie Ihres Ausweises
- Ihren Lebenslauf
- ein aktuelles Foto
reference:
For registration, we need the following documents:
- a copy of your ID
- your CV
- a recent photo

text:
Liebe Lea

Vielen Dank für deine Hilfe beim Umzug am Samstag. Ohne dich hätten wir es nicht geschafft.

Nächste Woche lade ich dich zum Abendessen ein.

Liebe Grüsse
Nina
reference:
Dear Lea

Thank you so much for your help with the move on Saturday. We couldn't have done it without you.

Next week I'm taking you out for dinner.

Best wishes
Nina

text: Ihre Arbeit ist gut strukturiert. Achten Sie beim nächsten Text aber besser auf die Quellenangaben.
reference: Your paper is well structured. In your next piece of work, however, pay closer attention to your references.

text: Der Austausch mit unserer Partnerschule in Riverside findet dieses Jahr im Mai statt.
reference: This year the exchange with our partner school in Riverside will take place in May.

text: Die Strasse vor dem Schulhaus ist ab Montag wegen Bauarbeiten gesperrt.
reference: The street in front of the school building will be closed from Monday because of construction work.

text:
Traktanden für die Sitzung vom Dienstag:
- Budget 2027
- neue Stundenpläne
- Verschiedenes
reference:
Agenda for Tuesday's meeting:
- 2027 budget
- new timetables
- any other business

text:
Liebe Eltern

Am Freitag, 14. Juni, feiert die Schule Weidenhof ihr Sommerfest. Wir freuen uns auf viele Besucherinnen und Besucher.

Bei schlechtem Wetter findet das Fest in der Turnhalle statt.
reference:
Dear parents

On Friday, 14 June, the Weidenhof school is holding its summer party. We look forward to welcoming many visitors.

If the weather is bad, the party will take place in the gym.

text: Hast du Lust, am Sonntag mit uns an den See zu kommen? Jonas bringt den Grill mit.
reference: Do you fancy coming to the lake with us on Sunday? Jonas is bringing the barbecue.

text: The new office in Otterbach opens on Monday. Please use the side entrance until the work is finished.
reference: Le nouveau bureau d'Otterbach ouvre lundi. Veuillez utiliser l'entrée latérale jusqu'à la fin des travaux.

text:
For the excursion on Friday, please bring:
- a packed lunch
- sturdy shoes
- a rain jacket
reference:
Pour l'excursion de vendredi, veuillez apporter :
- un pique-nique
- de bonnes chaussures
- une veste de pluie

text:
Dear Ms Example

Thank you for your registration. We will send you the timetable by the end of the month.
reference:
Madame Example,

Nous vous remercions de votre inscription. Nous vous enverrons l'emploi du temps d'ici la fin du mois.

text: Are you free on Saturday? We're having a few friends over for dinner and it would be great if you came.
reference: Tu es libre samedi ? On invite quelques amis à dîner et ce serait super si tu venais.

text: Sorry for the late reply. I was away for a few days and only saw your message this morning.
reference: Désolé pour cette réponse tardive. J'étais absent quelques jours et je n'ai vu votre message que ce matin.

text: La réunion de demain est reportée à jeudi, car Mme Exemple est malade. L'ordre du jour reste le même.
reference: Tomorrow's meeting has been postponed to Thursday because Ms Exemple is ill. The agenda stays the same.

text: L'échange avec notre école partenaire de Riverside aura lieu en mai cette année. Les inscriptions sont ouvertes jusqu'à la fin du mois.
reference: This year, the exchange with our partner school in Riverside will take place in May. Registration is open until the end of the month.

text:
Pour l'inscription, nous avons besoin des documents suivants :
- une copie de votre pièce d'identité
- une photo récente
- le formulaire signé
reference:
For the registration, we need the following documents:
- a copy of your identity card
- a recent photo
- the signed form

text: Votre travail est bien structuré. Pour le prochain texte, faites toutefois attention à citer correctement vos sources.
reference: Your work is well structured. For the next text, however, make sure you cite your sources correctly.

text:
Chère Léa,

Merci beaucoup pour ton aide lors du déménagement samedi. Sans toi, nous n'aurions jamais fini à temps.
reference:
Dear Léa

Thank you so much for your help with the move on Saturday. Without you, we would never have finished in time.

text: The Weidenhof school is closed on Monday because of a staff training day. Lessons start again on Tuesday.
reference: La scuola Weidenhof è chiusa lunedì a causa di una giornata di formazione del personale. Le lezioni riprendono martedì.

text: Please submit the completed form by 15 March at the latest. Late submissions cannot be considered.
reference: La preghiamo di inviare il modulo compilato entro il 15 marzo al più tardi. Gli invii tardivi non possono essere presi in considerazione.

text:
Before you leave the office:
- switch off the lights
- close the windows
- lock the door
reference:
Prima di lasciare l'ufficio:
- spegnete le luci
- chiudete le finestre
- chiudete a chiave la porta

text: Could you send me the slides from yesterday's meeting? I'd like to look at them again before Friday.
reference: Potresti mandarmi le diapositive della riunione di ieri? Vorrei riguardarle prima di venerdì.

text: Do you fancy coming to the lake with us on Sunday? Jonas is bringing the barbecue.
reference: Ti va di venire al lago con noi domenica? Jonas porta il barbecue.

text: La strada davanti alla scuola sarà chiusa da lunedì per lavori. Si prega di usare l'ingresso sul retro.
reference: The road in front of the school will be closed from Monday for roadworks. Please use the rear entrance.

text: Chi va a Otterbach in bicicletta può lasciarla gratuitamente alla stazione. Il deposito è aperto tutto il giorno.
reference: Anyone cycling to Otterbach can leave their bike at the station free of charge. The bike park is open all day.

text:
Ordine del giorno per la riunione di martedì:
- budget 2027
- nuovo orario
- varie
reference:
Agenda for Tuesday's meeting:
- budget 2027
- new timetable
- any other business

text:
Cari genitori,

Venerdì 14 giugno la scuola festeggia la sua festa d'estate. Siete tutti cordialmente invitati.
reference:
Dear parents

On Friday, 14 June, the school is holding its summer party. You are all cordially invited.

text: Ricordatevi di consegnare il compito entro giovedì. Chi ha domande può scrivermi in qualsiasi momento.
reference: Remember to hand in the assignment by Thursday. If you have any questions, you can write to me at any time.
